frames.board: board frame, mm: origin at the board's bottom-left corner, X along the forearm (X = 0 elbow end on a left wrist), Y = 0 antenna / root-B edge, viewed from the SKY = F.Cu = JLC top (V2-B lgeom convention)
frames.case: case frame of BASELINE 7: X_case = X_board + 1.5, Y_case = Y_board + 1.5

meta.h_max: maximum part height above the board top surface including solder (max-material stack of BASELINE 8: board top at Z 1.45 above the floor face); 0 = no parts (lands and keep-outs); null = no limit beyond the general zone
meta.rule: part courtyards must lie inside a zone whose h_max covers the part; zone edges already include 0.3 mm to the structure above them (rib, rail, K block, E3 shelf). Priority (lgeom_v3f.height_limit_at): keep-out / cut-out / antenna keep-out / no_parts = 0; a 'part' or 'land' zone gives its own h_max for that part; otherwise the lowest height_limit zone; otherwise the general zone
meta.source: v3/cad/src/geom_v3f.py board_zones(), skin_zones(); BASELINE.md 5.1, 7, 8; datasheets in v3/cad/ref/sources.md
